clue.text: Refuse in quarry

a quarry is the thing pursued, an aim or target

explanation.surface: Someone dumps rubbish in a quarry.
explanation.definitionFit: To refuse is to protest against something, and a quarry is a target or thing aimed at: two senses of one word.

clue.text: British line of business shows class

parts.note: a racket is slang for a line of business or trade

explanation.definitionFit: A bracket is a group or category, as in an income band.

parts.note: a race is an event at a sports meeting

indicators.note: first points to the opening letter of the word Towcester

explanation.surface: A flat race at a racecourse, minus a horse.
explanation.walkthrough: Towcester is an English racecourse in Northamptonshire; its first letter, T, comes off EVENT.
explanation.definitionFit: Even means level, as flat ground is.

clue.text: Person involved in test case is beginning to testify

parts.note: a court case is a trial

indicators.note: beginning to points to the first letter of the word testify

explanation.walkthrough: 'test case' looks like a single phrase, but 'test' ends the definition and 'case' gives TRIAL.
explanation.definitionFit: A trialist is a player who takes part in a trial match, a test of their selection.

clue.text: Tree in plot gets pelted

parts.note: a plot of garden ground is a bed
the ash is a common tree

explanation.surface: A tree growing on a plot of land is battered by the weather.
explanation.definitionFit: Pelted and bashed both mean struck hard and repeatedly.

clue.text: African academics branching out

parts.note: BAs are Bachelors of Arts, graduates

indicators.note: branching means heading off in new directions, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: University staff in Africa set off on new paths.
explanation.walkthrough: 'academics' reads as university staff in general, but it is plural graduates; 'branching' is the anagram signal on the short word that follows it.
explanation.definitionFit: Basuto is an older name for the Basotho people of Lesotho in southern Africa.

clue.text: Time suggesting doddery step and sign of fading passion?

indicators.note: doddery means shaky and unsteady, so the letters stagger into a new order

parts.note: an ember is a glowing remnant of a dying fire, a picture of passion fading

explanation.surface: An ageing romance: unsteady footsteps and the last glow of love.
explanation.definitionFit: September is a month, a period of the calendar.

clue.text: Letter, sufficient to prove a case

parts.note: EX is the spelt-out name of the letter X
ample means sufficient, enough

explanation.surface: A letter gives enough evidence to win a legal argument.
explanation.definitionFit: An instance or case can serve as an illustration of a general point.

clue.text: Meat surplus given to guys

parts.note: surplus means spare, left over
to guy someone is to mock them, as is to rib them; guys means ribs, teases

explanation.surface: Leftover meat is handed out to some men.
explanation.walkthrough: 'guys' looks like a noun for men, but it is the verb 'to guy', to tease, which is to rib.
explanation.definitionFit: Pork ribs with little flesh left on them are a cut of meat.

clue.text: In which you'd find ancient Greek remains?

definitions.text: In which you'd find ancient Greek remains?

parts.words: In which you'd find ancient Greek remains?
parts.note: a stone coffin holding a body, with a name from Greek meaning flesh-eating

clue.text: Drawings for vessels holding litre

explanation.definitionFit: Plans are technical drawings of a building or machine.

clue.text: A bat's visual aid

parts.note: the bat is a cricket batsman, and the aid is the white board behind the bowler that helps him see the ball

explanation.walkthrough: 'bat' suggests the flying animal, but in cricket a bat is a batsman.
explanation.definitionFit: A sightscreen is the large white board at a cricket ground placed so the batter can see the ball.

clue.text: Hanging factor? Liberal in speech got animated

indicators.note: animated means set moving and lively, so these letters are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A politician becomes heated while speaking about a hanging.
explanation.walkthrough: 'animated' rearranges L with the letters of SPEECH GOT; 'in' is a link joining them.
explanation.definitionFit: A peg holds washing on the line, an agent of hanging clothes out to dry.

clue.text: Hopeful type omits one point, extremely upset

explanation.surface: A hopeful person leaves out one point and is very distressed.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely upset' rearranges OMITS with I and PT.
explanation.definitionFit: An optimist is someone who expects good outcomes, a hopeful sort.

clue.text: Soaks in a stream, relaxing

indicators.note: relaxing loosens the letters, letting them fall into a new order

explanation.surface: Someone soaks in a stream, unwinding.
explanation.walkthrough: 'relaxing' rearranges the letters of IN A STREAM.
explanation.definitionFit: To marinate food is to steep or soak it in a seasoned liquid.

clue.text: European port Prime Minister ultimately consumed

indicators.note: consumed means the best has swallowed the letter, which goes inside

parts.note: prime means best, top quality

indicators.note: ultimately points to the final letter of the word Minister

explanation.surface: A prime minister eats at a European harbour town.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Prime Minister' looks like a single title, but it splits: 'Prime' gives BEST and 'Minister ultimately' gives R, which BEST 'consumed'.
explanation.definitionFit: Brest is a naval and fishing harbour in Brittany, France.

clue.text: Bicycle accessory, receptacle for carrying tools?

definitions.meaning: a casing over a bicycle chain and gears
gear means kit or equipment, so a box for kit

explanation.surface: A cyclist's kit includes a toolbox.
explanation.definitionFit: A cover enclosing a bicycle's chain and gearing, and literally a box for gear: two readings.

clue.text: Pusher's also an addict

definitions.meaning: one who hypes, a pushy promoter
a hype is slang for a drug user who injects, so one taking hypes is an addict

explanation.surface: A drug dealer is also hooked on what he sells.
explanation.definitionFit: A promoter who hypes products, and slang for a needle-using drug user: two senses of one word.

clue.text: Army type is in condition

indicators.note: in means the word is goes inside the soldier, one piece within another

parts.note: a Provo is a member of the Provisional IRA, the Irish Republican Army

explanation.surface: A soldier is in good shape.
explanation.walkthrough: Provo is the informal name for a member of the Provisional IRA.
explanation.definitionFit: A proviso is a condition or stipulation attached to an agreement.

clue.text: Quartet's act tried out

explanation.surface: A string quartet's performance is tried out on stage.
explanation.walkthrough: 'out' rearranges the letters of ACT TRIED.
explanation.definitionFit: A tetrad is a group of four, so tetradic describes a quartet.

clue.text: Bird's perch put up by man on board

indicators.note: put up in a down clue means written upwards, so the perch is read backwards

parts.note: a rod or perch is an old unit of length

explanation.walkthrough: The Dorking is a breed of chicken named after a town in Surrey.
explanation.definitionFit: The Dorking is a breed of domestic fowl, a bird.

clue.text: Wag's in school, for a change

explanation.definitionFit: A switch is a change from one thing to another.

clue.text: Milled piece in preparation

parts.note: milled grain is ground
a piece of art or writing is a work

explanation.surface: A machined part is being got ready.
explanation.definitionFit: Groundwork is the basic preliminary work, the preparation for a project.

clue.text: Spooky-sounding lake

indicators.note: sounding means the word is said aloud, so its sound gives the name

parts.note: spooky means eerie

explanation.surface: A lake with an eerie atmosphere.
explanation.definitionFit: Lake Erie is one of the Great Lakes of North America.

clue.text: Austrian composer identified with Mass in C, reportedly

definitions.meaning: Alban ..., the Viennese composer of the opera Wozzeck
said aloud, C is 'sea', so a mass in the sea: an iceberg

explanation.surface: A composer is credited with a Mass in C.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Mass in C' looks like a musical work, but heard aloud it is a mass in the sea, a short form of iceberg.
explanation.definitionFit: Alban Berg was an Austrian composer, and a berg is an ice mass floating at sea: two senses of one word.

clue.text: Women engaged in search for old ironist

indicators.note: engaged in means the women go inside the search, one piece within another

parts.note: to sift is to search through carefully

explanation.surface: Women take part in a hunt for an ironic writer of the past.
explanation.walkthrough: Jonathan Swift (1667-1745) wrote the satire 'A Modest Proposal', famous for its irony.
explanation.definitionFit: Jonathan Swift, the eighteenth-century Irish satirist, is a classic master of irony.

clue.text: Actor in blue film?

parts.note: blue suggests a pornographic film, but here it means sad: a performer in a sad drama

explanation.definitionFit: A tragedian is an actor who specialises in tragic roles, and tragedy is a sorrowful, blue drama.

clue.text: Soup and cut of lamb or schnitzel

explanation.walkthrough: 'cut of' takes letters from inside 'lamB OR SCHnitzel'.

clue.text: Bind book

to book is to hire or reserve, as a performer

explanation.surface: A bookbinder at work.
explanation.definitionFit: To bind is to commit by promise, and to book is to hire a performer: two senses of one word.
